title: Example Port
tagline: The game, rebuilt from scratch, in your browser
fine: A copy of the original game is required. The files stay in this browser and are never uploaded.

items.title: Welcome
items.text: Choose your game files below, then press **Start the game**.

sections.label: Game files
steps: Find the folder where the game is installed.
Choose `GAME.DAT` and `LEVELS.PAK` together, or drop them on this page.

sections.label: Saves
help: Saves from the original game or from the desktop version can be added here.

sections.label: Mods
help: Mods that are on load when the game starts. A mod lower in the list wins.
